bugs_found: apply_fee raises ImportError instead of ValueError for negative amount, silently changing the public error contract and potentially bypassing callers that catch validation failures
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal; float/string/adversarial numeric inputs can raise TypeError or introduce inconsistent behavior unlike the other finance functions
transfer is not atomic: account_from is debited before account_to is credited, so a failure in crediting the destination can leave balances inconsistent
